topics.title: Property, Plant & Equipment
topics.objective: To obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence over the existence, completeness, valuation, rights and presentation of PPE.
procedures: Obtain/prepare lead schedule and reconcile it with the general ledger.
Analyse additions, disposals and depreciation against prior year and budget.
Test selected additions to invoices, approvals, delivery/installation evidence and asset register.
Examine disposals and gains/losses, including cut-off around year end.
Review physical-verification process, discrepancies and condition/impairment indicators.
Assess depreciation method, useful lives and disclosure.

topics.title: Capital Work-in-Progress
topics.objective: To assess completeness, valuation, classification and timely capitalisation of CWIP.
procedures: Obtain CWIP schedule and reconcile with general ledger.
Test material project costs to contracts, bills, engineer certificates and approvals.
Review project status and identify completed projects requiring capitalisation.
Evaluate capitalisation of overheads and borrowing costs.

topics.title: Intangible Assets
topics.objective: To verify recognition, ownership, valuation and disclosure of intangible assets.
procedures: Reconcile intangible asset schedule with general ledger.
Inspect agreements, registrations and valuation evidence for material assets.
Review impairment indicators and amortisation methods/useful lives.

topics.title: Right of Use Assets
topics.objective: To verify recognition, measurement and disclosure of right-of-use assets.
procedures: Obtain lease register and reconcile ROU assets to general ledger.
Inspect significant lease agreements and evaluate lease term.
Reperform selected ROU asset and depreciation computations.
Review presentation and disclosure under applicable framework.

topics.title: Depreciation & Amortization
topics.objective: To test the accuracy and appropriateness of depreciation and amortisation.
procedures: Obtain depreciation/amortisation working and reconcile with trial balance.
Reperform selected calculations, rates and useful lives.
Review changes in methods, residual values and estimates.

topics.title: Investments
topics.objective: To verify existence, rights, valuation, income and disclosure of investments.
procedures: Reconcile investment schedule with register and general ledger.
Inspect approvals, acquisition/disposal documents and ownership evidence.

topics.title: Trade Receivables
topics.objective: To verify existence, completeness, valuation and recoverability of trade receivables.
procedures: Obtain customer-wise ageing and reconcile it to general ledger.
Perform current/prior-year variance and ageing analysis.
Select balances for external confirmation; track responses and differences.
Perform alternative procedures for non-responses, including subsequent receipts.
Assess expected credit loss/provision and related disclosure.

topics.title: Cash & Bank
topics.objective: To verify existence, completeness, rights and valuation of cash and bank balances.
procedures: Obtain bank reconciliations and reconcile balances to general ledger.
Obtain/directly control bank confirmations and FD evidence.
Test stale reconciliation items and subsequent clearance.

topics.title: Other Financial Assets
topics.objective: To verify other financial assets, including deposits and accrued income.
procedures: Obtain schedule and reconcile it with general ledger.

topics.title: Share Capital
topics.objective: To verify authorisation, issue, valuation and disclosure of share capital.
procedures: Reconcile share capital lead schedule to general ledger and prior year.
Inspect board/shareholder approvals and statutory filings.
Verify issue/allotment evidence, valuation and shareholder register.

topics.title: Other Equity
topics.objective: To verify movements and presentation within other equity.
procedures: Reconcile reserves and retained earnings with prior year and current profit.
Review transactions affecting reserves and supporting approvals.

topics.title: Loans & Borrowings
topics.objective: To verify completeness, valuation, terms and presentation of borrowings.
procedures: Obtain loan schedule and reconcile with general ledger.
Inspect sanction letters, agreements, security and covenant compliance.
Confirm material balances and reperform interest/repayment calculations.

topics.title: Finance Costs
topics.objective: To verify completeness, accuracy and classification of finance costs.
procedures: Reconcile finance-cost schedule with general ledger.
Recompute selected interest charges against agreements.
Assess capitalisation and disclosure where relevant.

topics.title: Lease Liabilities
topics.objective: To verify lease-liability recognition, measurement and disclosure.
procedures: Obtain lease-liability working and lease register.
Inspect significant agreements and reperform selected present-value calculations.

topics.title: Trade Payables
topics.objective: To verify completeness, existence, valuation and classification of trade payables.
procedures: Obtain vendor ageing and reconcile to general ledger.
Perform variance, ageing and debit-balance analysis.
Send confirmations and perform subsequent-payment procedures as needed.
Perform year-end unrecorded-liability and cut-off testing.

topics.title: Other Financial Liabilities
topics.objective: To verify completeness, valuation and disclosure of other financial liabilities.
procedures: Inspect supporting agreements and reperform material computations.

topics.title: Tax Liabilities
topics.objective: To verify tax liabilities and related reconciliations/disclosures.
procedures: Reconcile statutory tax schedules/returns with books.
Inspect assessment orders, demands, refunds and payments.

topics.title: Other Current Liabilities
topics.objective: To verify completeness and classification of other current liabilities.
procedures: Obtain detailed schedule and reconcile to general ledger.
Test statutory dues, customer advances and material provisions.

topics.title: Deferred Tax Liabilities
topics.objective: To verify deferred-tax balances and related disclosures.
procedures: Obtain deferred-tax working and reconcile movements.
Test temporary differences, tax rates and recognition basis.
Review presentation in profit/loss, OCI/equity and notes.

topics.title: Revenue from Operations
topics.objective: To verify occurrence, cut-off, accuracy and presentation of revenue.
procedures: Obtain revenue ledger/dump and reconcile to financial statements and tax returns.
Perform trend, product/customer and cut-off analysis.
Test selected invoices to contracts, orders, delivery evidence and receipts.
Test invoice-number sequence, cancellations, returns and credit notes.
Assess applicable revenue-recognition requirements and disclosures.

topics.title: Other Income
topics.objective: To verify occurrence, accuracy, cut-off and disclosure of other income.
procedures: Reconcile other-income schedule with general ledger.
Test material interest, dividend, gain and rental income to evidence.
Perform year-end cut-off and accrual testing.

topics.title: Inventories
topics.objective: To verify existence, completeness, valuation and cut-off of inventories.
procedures: Reconcile inventory summary to general ledger.
Attend/evaluate physical count and test records to floor/floor to records.
Test valuation, costing and NRV for selected items.
Review slow-moving/obsolete stock provision and disclosures.

topics.title: Employee Benefits
topics.objective: To verify completeness, accuracy and valuation of employee-benefit balances and costs.
procedures: Reconcile payroll and employee-benefit schedules to general ledger.
Test selected employees to appointment, payroll and attendance records.
Test statutory contributions, leave/bonus and actuarial valuation where relevant.

topics.title: Expenses
topics.objective: To verify occurrence, accuracy, classification and cut-off of expenses.
procedures: Perform analytical review and identify unusual movements.
Test selected vouchers to approvals, invoices, agreements and payment evidence.
Test TDS/GST and year-end accrual/prepayment cut-off.

topics.title: Going Concern
topics.objective: To evaluate management's use of the going-concern basis in accordance with SA 570 (Revised).
procedures: Assess financial, operating and other indicators of going-concern risk.
Analyse net worth, liquidity, leverage, profitability and operating cash flows.
Evaluate management forecasts, mitigation plans and evidence of feasibility.
Assess adequacy of financial-statement disclosures and conclusion.

topics.title: Laws & Regulations
topics.objective: To identify applicable laws and regulations and respond to identified or suspected non-compliance.
procedures: Obtain management's list of significant applicable laws and regulations.
Make enquiries and inspect correspondence/returns for non-compliance.
Evaluate effect on financial statements and reporting obligations.

topics.title: Subsequent Events
topics.objective: To identify events between the reporting date and audit-report date under SA 560.
procedures: Read board/member minutes and make management enquiries.
Review post-year-end financial information and material transactions.
Obtain representation and assess adjusting/non-adjusting treatment.

topics.title: Related Party Transactions
topics.objective: To identify, evaluate and disclose related parties and related-party transactions.
procedures: Obtain related-party list and reconcile with declarations, minutes and registers.
Identify and test material/unusual related-party transactions.
Evaluate approvals, arm's-length evidence and disclosures.

topics.title: Internal Control over Financial Reporting
topics.objective: To understand, evaluate and test relevant ICFR design and operating effectiveness.
procedures: Document significant processes, risks and key controls.
Test design and operating effectiveness of selected controls.

topics.title: Journal Entry Testing
topics.objective: To respond to management-override risk through journal-entry testing under SA 240.
procedures: Understand journal-entry process and relevant controls.
Analyse and select unusual, period-end and manual entries for testing.
Test selected entries to supporting evidence and business rationale.
Document findings and impact on fraud-risk assessment.

topics.title: Contingent Liabilities
topics.objective: To identify, evaluate and appropriately disclose contingencies and commitments.
procedures: Enquire of management and review legal/tax correspondence and minutes.
Assess likelihood/measurement with management and experts where necessary.

topics.title: Use of Work of Experts
topics.objective: To evaluate competence, capabilities, objectivity and adequacy of expert work.
procedures: Document need for expert and scope of work.
Assess adequacy and consistency of expert findings with other evidence.

topics.title: Work of Internal Auditors
topics.objective: To evaluate whether and how work of internal audit may be used under SA 610.
procedures: Assess objectivity, competence and systematic approach of internal audit.
Determine intended use and perform evaluation/reperformance of selected work.
Document conclusion and impact on audit procedures.

topics.title: Secretarial Compliances
topics.objective: To evaluate key secretarial records, approvals and filings relevant to the audit.
procedures: Inspect statutory registers, minutes and key ROC filings.
Test relevant authorisations for significant corporate actions.

topics.title: ESOPs
topics.objective: To verify authorisation, measurement and disclosure of employee share-based payments.
procedures: Inspect scheme, constitutional documents and board/shareholder approvals.
Test grants, vesting, valuation inputs and accounting computation.

topics.title: CARO Reporting (Companies Auditor's Report Order)
topics.objective: To obtain evidence for each reporting clause of the Order applicable to the company and conclude on reporting.
procedures: Determine applicability of the Order for the year (thresholds, exemptions) and document the basis.

For each applicable clause, obtain management's response and map it to audit evidence (fixed assets and inventory records, loans and investments, statutory dues, borrowings, fraud, related parties, internal audit, etc.).
Evaluate matters requiring adverse or qualified comment and discuss with management.
Prepare the draft clause-wise report and link each clause to working paper references.

topics.title: Income-tax & TDS Compliance
topics.objective: To evaluate income-tax computation, tax provisions and TDS / TCS compliance.
procedures: Review computation of total income, deductions claimed, MAT / tax provision and reconciliation of tax expense.
Review TDS / TCS deduction, deposit and returns; reconcile with books and Form 26AS / AIS.
Review advance tax, interest, filing dates, pending assessments, demands and appeals; assess contingent liabilities.

topics.title: GST Compliance
topics.objective: To evaluate GST registration, returns, input tax credit and reconciliations.
procedures: Reconcile turnover and output tax in returns with books and financial statements.
Review input tax credit availed against GSTR-2B, eligibility, reversals and blocked credits.
Review reverse charge, e-invoicing / e-way bill applicability, annual return and reconciliation statement.
Review notices, demands and disclosure of GST contingencies.

topics.title: Tax Audit (Form 3CD) Clauses
topics.objective: To obtain evidence for the clauses of the tax audit report applicable to the assessee.
procedures: Determine applicability of tax audit and obtain the list of clauses applicable to the entity.
Test clause-wise information (e.g. depreciation, payments to specified persons, disallowances, TDS defaults, loans and deposits, etc.) with books and documents.
Document adverse remarks, qualifications and reconciliation with the financial statements.
